compiled_state.title: [dso-shim]: worktree session executes main-repo plugin -> in-worktree plugin edits invisible until merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: Discovered during bug 19a3-03ca-6c89-4e1b (ticket-cli perf fix), code_version fb00f39f02f64511cae24fd9c9dfb3e747e78457. The dso shim prefers CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (set by Claude Code to the main-repo plugin path) over the relative dso.plugin_root config. Consequence: plugin script edits in a worktree session are invisible to dso shim invocations; the shim executes the main-repo copy. Confirmed by forcing CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT to the worktree plugin -- 8-hex timing immediately dropped from 67s to 286ms. Suggested fix directions: (1) in a worktree session, prefer worktree-resolved dso.plugin_root over CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; (2) have Claude Code set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT to the worktree-local plugin path; (3) detect worktree mode in the shim and reverse precedence. Orthogonal to the perf fix; affects developer experience for any plugin work in a worktree.

comments.body: User confirms current behavior is desired: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT precedence over relative dso.plugin_root in worktree sessions is intentional. Closing as not-a-bug.
comments.author: Test
